html:
If you are staying in Hanoi and looking for a flexible Hanoi City private car, including a visit to Bat Trang Ceramic Village, Vietlook Travel is pleased to offer you a comfortable door-to-door private transfer with an experienced driver.

This private car service allows you to explore Hanoi at your own pace, choose your departure time, and customize the itinerary according to your interests.

Hanoi To Bat Trang Tour

At your preferred time (recommended at 8:00 AM), our driver and private car will pick you up at your hotel lobby in Hanoi city center.

Suggested itinerary:

  • Ho Chi Minh Complex (outside visit): Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Presidential Palace, One Pillar Pagoda

  • Temple of Literature – Vietnam’s first university

  • West Lake & Tran Quoc Pagoda

  • Old Quarter – photo stops & short walks

  • Bat Trang Ceramic Village

    • Visit traditional ceramic workshops

    • Explore Bat Trang ancient village & market

    • Try making pottery by yourself (optional)

Along the way, you can request stops for coffee, lunch, restrooms, or sightseeing. The itinerary is fully flexible within 8 hours.

After finishing the tour, our driver will transfer you back to your hotel in Hanoi, ending the Hanoi City 8-hour private car service.

Vietlook Travel wishes you a wonderful time discovering Hanoi

TRAVEL NOTES

  • Bat Trang Ceramic Village entrance: Free (pottery experience fee if applicable)

  • Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: Closed on Monday & Friday

  • Modest dress is recommended when visiting temples and pagodas

WHY SHOULD YOU CHOOSE US?

  • Door-to-door private car service

  • Flexible itinerary & departure time

  • Experienced, friendly drivers

  • Comfortable cars with strong A/C & seat belts

  • No hidden costs – best local price

  • Free baby seat (upon request)

  • 24/7 support via Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588 | (+84) 98.339.3488 (Zalo / WhatsApp / WeChat)
